title: Named FIFO edge + non-root escape
sub: the fix's readlink pipe: check protects host inodes; the escape is not root-specific
body: -- B parent   link=/root/.../myfifo      data=[fifo-payload-bytes]   chmod=ok   host FIFO mode 644 -> 666
++ A fix      link=socket:[...] (copied)  data=[fifo-payload-bytes]   chmod hits pipe   host FIFO mode still 644
== a named FIFO's readlink is a path, not 'pipe:', so the fix copies it instead of sharing the host fd.
== uid 65534 (nobody), inherited stdin fd — policy read-only/closed
-- B parent   < user-owned host file   link=/tmp/.../owned.txt   fd0-write=ok        owned.txt = via-fd0   OVERWRITTEN
-- B parent   < host dir, walk ..       root-walk=ok              from-host-root.txt CREATED outside ws
++ A fix      < user-owned host file   link=socket:[...]         fd0-blocked (ENXIO)  owned.txt = nobody-original
++ A fix      < host dir, walk ..       Directory nonexistent     from-host-root.txt absent
== the descriptor escape and its closure both hold for a non-root user; not a privilege artifact.
